observations.title: The pod reaches the node kubelet on :10250 despite default-deny egress
observations.source: docs/STATUS.md open finding 1; docs/WORKLOG.md, live deployment findings
facts: Observed on the live lab: default-deny egress does not block pod to local node traffic; the kubelet port 10250 is reachable from the pod.
Stated in docs/STATUS.md, not recorded as a separate probe result: the kubelet requires authentication.
Stated in docs/STATUS.md: restrict this before running untrusted workloads.
